# Itiner-e static 2024 v1.3 sample

`roads-v1.3.geojson` retains unmodified features with `InLine_FID` 0 and 1874,
including every original property, elevation coordinate and collection CRS.
The collection is a subset of `itinere_roads.geojson` in
https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.17122148, downloaded November 5, 2026 at 21:42 UTC.
Full source SHA-256: `4f8f5cf99f387bab2c509b1bf50143e9a3117691e316f2f46a9bb1d3d4b1cc34`.

Credit de Soto, Pažout, Brughmans et al., *A High-Resolution Dataset of Roads of
the Roman Empire: Itiner-e static version 2024*, version 1.3. The official
project About page (https://www.itiner-e.org/about) licenses Itiner-e under
CC BY 4.0 and links this static release. The release API omits a license field;
clearance is based on the official project's stated license, not the API's
`open` access flag or the accompanying article's license.

Feature 0 has `9999` unknown-date sentinels. Feature 1874 has reported date
estimates and uncertainty fields. Neither feature's test endpoint IDs nor the
unit-test mapping constitute historical approval.
